tools.name: evaluate_eligibility
tools.description:
Score one (agent, task) pair. Returns the scorer's full result dict as JSON text:
    decision (CLEAR/HOLD/FAIL), score 0-100, confidence, reasons, next_action,
    plus evaluation metadata. Unknown (null) evidence counts as unverified.

tools.name: get_scoring_table
tools.description:
Return the v1.0.0 deduction table, decision bands, confidence rules, and
    rules version as JSON, so a client can display the published rules.

tools.name: list_paid_services
tools.description: List the paid x402 services offered by Payne Machine Foundry (prices, endpoints, how to buy). The MCP tools themselves are free.
